She works as the Battle Studies teacher at [[Naranja Academy]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]{{sup/9|V}}. She [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Fighting}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In the core series games== {{incomplete|section|needs=Section for information regarding their appearance and interactions as a Special Coach at the [[Blueberry Academy]] [[League Club Room]]}} Dendra is an energetic young woman and uses that energy while teaching. She always refers to the player as "new kid". In [[Bonds|forming bonds]] with her, she admits that while she is athletic, she is not good at cooking, especially making sandwiches. She improves her cooking by learning more from the player's feedback and practicing with [[Saguaro]]. Dendra reveals that she wants to make sandwiches for [[Miriam]] as gratitude, since the latter often patches up her injuries. Dendra looks up to Miriam because she is nice and skilled, and she wanted to learn a skill to help others the way Miriam does. She realizes that although she isn't skilled at making sandwiches, she decides to focus on being full of energy. Dendra participates in the [[Academy Ace Tournament]], including the scripted first round. The player can also find her in [[Alfornada]], assisting in her childhood friend [[Tulip]]'s Gym Test of ESP exercise, even after the player has already defeated the Gym. This is because Dendra lost a battle with Tulip due to her Fighting type Pokémon being a bad matchup against her Psychic Pokémon, with the stakes being that whoever lost had to do whatever the victor wanted. According to Tulip, Dendra praises the player's skills in the Gym Test. ===Pokémon=== Dendra will always {{Tera}}stallize her {{p|Hariyama}}. ====[[Academy Ace Tournament]] (before catching {{color2|000|Pokémon Scarlet and Violet|Scarlet and Violet}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Dendra/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Dendra anime.png|thumb|250px|Dendra in {{aniseries|HZ}}]] ===''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''=== Dendra first appeared in ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]''. She was first seen at [[Naranja Academy]], explaining the basics of the [[Tera Training]] course to [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'' and ''[[HZ056|Liko vs. Rika! Towards the Battle's End]]'', Dendra worked as a [[Battle judge|referee]] during the [[Elite Four Tag Battle]]. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', alongside Clavell, Dendra explained the rules of the second part of Tera Training to the participating students. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Dendra was in charge of being a referee for the Naranja Academy battle tournament taking place. She later informed Liko and Roy that they would be battling each other in the school tournament. In ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]'', Dendra caught [[Ult]] trying to eat the food at Naranja Academy and, thinking he was someone with bad intentions, chased him around the institution with {{an|Nemona}}. After catching him, and meeting up with Liko, Roy and Dot, she discovered that he was a member of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] as well, after which Dendra served as a referee for Roy's battle against Nemona. ====Character==== Dendra has an enthusiastic and upbeat personality, with a passion for working out and teaching students about [[Pokémon battle]]s. She is encouraging to students in their endeavors, always motivating them to do their best. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dendra |pkmn=Hariyama |type1=Fighting |img=Dendra Hariyama.png |epnum=HZ046 |epname=Welcome to Naranja Academy! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Hariyama}} is Dendra's only known Pokémon. ''{{color2|000|Pokémon Horizons: The Series}}'' |} ===Pokémon: Paldean Winds=== [[File:Dendra Paldean Winds.png|thumb|250px|Dendra in [[Pokémon: Paldean Winds]]]] Dendra briefly appeared in ''[[PPW04|Breathe Together]]'', during [[Ohara]], [[Aliquis]], and [[Hohma]]'s video presenting [[Naranja Academy]]. ====Pokémon==== {| | {{ActivePoké|Dendra|Medicham|0308Medicham.png|Fighting|Psychic|size=100px|link=no}} | |} {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Saguaro Dendra Miriam Adventures.png|thumb|370px|Dendra in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Dendra debuted in ''[[PASV01|Speeding! Paldea's Prince of Speed!!]]''. She was first seen taking part in the opening ceremony for [[Uva Academy]]'s Treasure Hunt. When a student named {{Violet}} crashed the presentation, Dendra and two other teachers attempted to stop him. Violet agreed to accept punishment for his actions, but only if he was defeated in a race. Accepting this challenge, Dendra, Violet, and the two other teachers raced around the academy's courtyard. Despite being the only competitor on foot instead of riding a Pokémon, Dendra ended up winning the race when Violet got distracted by [[Arven]]. Later, Dendra and the other teachers were called to an emergency meeting by [[Clavell]], who informed them of Violet's backstory and explained his behavior. In [[PASV19]], at the Uva Academy staff room, Dendra talked to Clavell about {{Scarlet}}. Dendra revealed that despite Scarlet's school records claiming she had perfect attendance and a battle record comparable to [[Nemona]]'s, she had never actually seen Scarlet before the opening ceremony. Clavell suspected that Scarlet may have infiltrated the school for some reason. Later, [[Penny]] encountered [[Saguaro]], Dendra, and [[Miriam]] at the entrance hall of [[Uva Academy]]. Dendra tried getting Saguaro to try her sandwich made entirely of meat products despite Miriam's protests that it would result in severe stomach issues. Saguaro secretly preferred sweets, so he tried to pass the sandwich off to Penny, only for Miriam to help her escape by sending her out the building. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dendra |pkmn=Medicham |type1=Fighting |type2=Psychic |img=Dendra Medicham Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PASV19 |epname= |desc={{p|Medicham}} is Dendra's only known Pokémon. It was first seen standing beside its Trainer in the [[Uva Academy]] staff room. None of Medicham's moves are known.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:DendraPaldeaEvolved266.jpg|200px|thumb|Special illustration rare Dendra]] {{main|Dendra (Paldea Evolved 179)}} '''Dendra''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Triplet Beat}} subset and the English {{TCG|Paldea Evolved}} expansion, with artwork by [[yuu]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version with artwork by the same artist, and a {{TCG|special illustration rare}} version of the card with artwork by [[GIDORA]] were released in the same sets. It allows players to put a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck. If they do, the player draws cards until they have 5 cards in their hand. Because this card's effect requires the player to put another card on the bottom of their deck, this card cannot be played if it is the last card in the player's hand. {{-}} ==Trivia== * After Dendra recalls her Pokémon from battle, she pats the Poké Ball rather than simply nodding at it like many Trainers. * Due to her role in Tulip's Gym Test, Dendra can be found standing in two places at once indefinitely: [[Alfornada]] and the Academy. * All of the moves used by Dendra's Pokémon are [[physical move]]s. ** This also applies to the Meditite she gives to the player as a [[Gift Pokémon|gift]]. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{fighting color}}; border:3px solid #{{fighting color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fighting color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{fighting color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{fighting color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | キハダ ''Kihada'' | From 黄蘗 ''kihada'' ({{wp|Phellodendron amurense|Amur cork tree}}) |- | English, Italian,
